levels.terse: A short pitch: the subject and little else.
levels.rich: The same subject with many creative details: colours, character, accessories, mood, in plain words.

subjects.rich: A proud old lion resting with his head held high. A huge shaggy mane fading from golden blond at the face to dark chocolate at the edges, a tawny body with a pale cream belly and muzzle, amber eyes, a broad black nose, a scar across one eyebrow, big padded paws and a long tail ending in a dark tuft.

An emperor penguin chick's proud parent. Glossy blue-black back and head, a crisp white belly blending into a warm golden-yellow patch at the neck and ear, a long slender beak with an orange-pink stripe, stubby flippers held slightly out, and big black feet. A fluffy grey chick peeks out from between its feet.

A lined seahorse holding on to a strand of seagrass with its curled tail. A ridged body in sunny yellow with thin dark lines and a few white freckles, a little crown of spikes on its head, a long tube snout, a delicate fluttering fin on its back, and big, curious eyes.

A nine-banded armadillo trotting along. A shell of overlapping banded plates in dusty pinkish-tan, a pointy snout, tall leathery ears, small beady eyes, sturdy clawed feet and a long armoured tail tapering to a point. A sprinkle of coarse pale hairs pokes out between the bands.

An emperor dragonfly hovering above a pond. A long, slim abdomen in electric blue with black markings down its back, an apple-green thorax, huge wraparound turquoise eyes, and four glassy wings with a fine net of dark veins and a faint golden sheen, held flat and wide. Six thin legs are tucked under it.

A sleepy koala hugging a eucalyptus branch. Soft ash-grey fur with a cream chest and cream-lined fluffy ears, a big black leathery nose, half-closed drowsy brown eyes, strong grey paws with dark claws, and a sprig of blue-green eucalyptus leaves in one hand, mid-munch.

A small forest spirit, part deer and part mossy stone. A body of grey river stone covered in soft green moss, slender wooden legs ending in little hooves, branching antlers sprouting tiny white flowers and leaves, a pale wooden mask-like face with two glowing green eyes, and a few fireflies circling its head.

A brass explorer's telescope on a wooden tripod. A long tube in polished brass with leather-wrapped sections and engraved rings, a smaller finder scope on top, an eyepiece with a rubber cup, focusing knobs, and a mahogany tripod with brass fittings and a little tray holding a rolled star chart.

A 1930s typewriter in glossy racing green. Round keys with cream letters on chrome rims in four staggered rows, a semicircle of thin type bars behind them, a chrome carriage return lever, a black platen roller with a sheet of paper half typed, and a small brass maker's badge on the front.

A cozy treehouse diorama on a grassy round base. A thick old oak with a wide leafy crown, a little wooden cabin with a red shingle roof and a round window nestled in its branches, a rope ladder and a wooden swing hanging below, a pennant flag on the roof, a lantern by the door, and a few mushrooms and a bicycle at the foot of the tree.
